label: Captain by Morning
summary: The crew of the Merry Widow has just voted out their captain and voted you in. You have until morning to prove them right.
title: Captain by Morning
description: Last night the crew of the Merry Widow voted out Captain Redgrave for hiding a treasure map from them, and then, to everyone's surprise including yours, voted you in. Redgrave is locked in the brig, the map is missing, an Admiralty frigate is on the horizon and the crew wants to know what their new captain's orders are.

chapterOutlines.title: The Vote
chapterOutlines.outline: Take command of a crew that is not sure about you.

chapterOutlines.title: Saltmother
chapterOutlines.outline: Sell, trade and scheme in the free port.

chapterOutlines.title: The Drowned Queen's Map
chapterOutlines.outline: Follow the map through storms, reefs and rival crews.

chapterOutlines.title: The Treasure
chapterOutlines.outline: Find out if the Drowned Queen's treasure is real, and what it costs.

scene.location: The deck of the Merry Widow, at sunrise, the morning after the vote
scene.summary: Forty pirates are looking at you. The bosun hands you the captain's hat. It is slightly too big.

openThreads: Who on the crew still supports Redgrave?
Why is the Admiralty after this ship?

npcs.name: Bosun Tallow Jones
npcs.description: A barrel-chested bosun with a parrot that only swears in old Imperial. He nominated you and wants to know if he was right.
goals: A fair share for every hand
abilities: Can be heard over a hurricane

npcs.name: Captain Silas Redgrave
npcs.role: Former captain, now in the brig
npcs.description: The deposed captain, charming even in chains, who swears the map is cursed and that he hid it to save the crew.

npcs.name: Nell Okafor
npcs.description: The ship's navigator, who can read stars, currents and lies equally well.

relationships.label: Navigator
relationships.status: Watching to see if you fail
